Response to Comments:
STATEMENT N
ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION AGENCY (REGION V)
1. Corridor's #3 and #5 are totally within the 1974 NEF contours for General Mitchell Field and the addition of the Airport Spur will cause little impact because the area is already impacted by a higher noise source (Mitchell Field). The remaining corridors fall partially outside the NEF contours and the addition of the Airport Spur will cause more impact because of the introduction of a high noise source.
Prediction of 1990 NEF contours would be very difficult. Please see page 125 of the Final E.I.S. Any corridor, however, that would fall within the NEF contours would also cause less impact.
2. Borrow material is discussed on page 146.
3. There will be no excess excavation material generated on this project. However, earth berms and noise barriers will be constructed as discussed on page 150.
